assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness in the setting of known sick sinus syndrome and a personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction.
Mobile cardiac telemetry is ordered to correlate these symptomatic events with underlying arrhythmias and to optimize rate control management.
Mobile cardiac telemetry is coded with CPT 93229.
The diagnosis code I49.5 is documented.
The claim was denied under reason code CO-22.
The denial is for mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229).
The payer is Prairie State Medicaid (payer_id prairie).
